description: Edit the text of one of YOUR OWN discussion comments on a work item (also on a DONE item). The comment keeps its id and visibility, gains `editedAt`, and its attachments are untouched. Same rule as the Console: only the key owner's own comment can be edited; someone else's is 403 not_comment_author, a Linear-mirrored comment or a shared-report reader's comment is 403 comment_not_editable, an unknown id is 404 comment_not_found. Requires `write` scope and a key owner who is an editor or above. Find comment ids with anyforge_list_work_item_comments.

body.description: The new comment text. Replaces the old text.

name: anyforge_edit_work_item_comment
title: Edit work item comment
